7.en: The trail is steep, so take your time.

9.en: Keep a steady hand when you take the photo.

11.en: Let us establish a time for the next call.
11.zh: 我们定个时间安排下次通话吧。

17.en: You cannot erase a message after it has been sent.
17.zh: 消息发出后就无法删除。

19.en: Do not spill coffee on the keyboard.

22.en: He acted out of spite after losing the game.
22.zh: 输掉比赛后，他出于怨恨故意捣乱。

23.en: Despite the rain, the event went ahead.
23.zh: 尽管下雨，活动还是照常举行。

25.en: Spray the plant with water every morning.

28.en: The balloon swelled in the heat.

31.en: I tested a sample of the new tea.
31.zh: 我尝了新茶的一个样品。

33.en: We insure our phones against accidental damage.
33.zh: 我们为手机投保，以防意外损坏。

34.en: I assure you that the files are safe.
34.zh: 我向你保证，文件是安全的。

38.en: We reached a compromise on the meeting time.
38.zh: 我们就开会时间达成了妥协。

39.en: The company pledged to reduce plastic waste.
39.zh: 公司承诺减少塑料垃圾。

40.en: She alleges that the account was hacked.
40.zh: 她声称账户遭到了黑客入侵。
